mapper.select: SELECT * FROM system_user WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE system_user SET login_failed_count = 0, login_failure_window_started_at = NULL, login_locked_until = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT u.* FROM system_user u
ORDER BY u.sort_order ASC, u.id ASC

SELECT u.* FROM system_user u
ORDER BY u.sort_order ASC, u.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.real_name, u.enabled FROM system_user u
AND u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{username}, '%')
AND u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{realName}, '%')
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM system_user_role protected_ur INNER JOIN system_role protected_r ON protected_r.id = protected_ur.role_id WHERE protected_ur.user_id = u.id AND protected_r.role_type = 'SYSTEM' )
AND u.enabled = 1
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM system_user_role ur WHERE ur.user_id = u.id AND ur.role_id = #{roleId} )
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM system_user_role ur WHERE ur.user_id = u.id AND ur.role_id = #{roleId} )
ORDER BY u.sort_order ASC, u.id ASC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) FROM system_user u INNER JOIN system_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN system_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE u.enabled = 1 AND r.role_code = #{roleCode}
AND u.id != #{excludedUserId}
